purpose: OpenGameAgent P2 scheduler acceptance workload only; not a product or runtime default

evidence.actorCount: host-required P2 acceptance workload: exactly 256 registered actor lanes
evidence.runsPerActor: host-required P2 acceptance workload: exactly 32 admitted runs per actor lane
evidence.maxActiveActors: host-required P2 acceptance workload: exactly 8 simultaneously active actor lanes
evidence.maxQueuedRuns: derived as actorCount multiplied by runsPerActor so the synchronous burst exactly fills the configured waiting-run capacity
evidence.maxInputBytes: derived as the exact canonical JSON and UTF-8 byte length of the benchmark's null payload
evidence.maxInputDepth: derived as the runtime's admitted positive minimum because the benchmark's null payload has no nested container
evidence.progressTimeoutMs: reference-derived from the locked Vitest 4.1.11 non-browser per-test default; the deadline resets on every observed progress event and is not a runtime timeout default
